bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
a=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 71
test "$a" -gt 0 || exit 72
r=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='room' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 73
g=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 74
test "$g" = 1 || exit 75
o=$(q "SELECT count(DISTINCT board_key) FROM posting_topics WHERE enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND ((board_key='area_bbs' AND message_thread_id=116) OR (board_key='video_chat' AND message_thread_id=1605) OR (board_key='gay_board' AND message_thread_id=4)) AND purpose IN ('announcement','room')") || exit 76
test "$o" = 3 || exit 77
if test "$r" -gt 0; then
 rg=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='room' AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 78
 test "$rg" = 1 || exit 79
fi
echo ROOM_REGISTRY_AND_RELEASE_GATE_PASS
